observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission/gearbox sitting on gravel with a tarp behind it.
The casing is dirty and oily; no readable brand, model, or part number plate is visible in the photo.
A watermark reading "BLESSED CHILD" overlays the center of the image.
The bell housing and output area are visible; no torque converter is clearly attached.
The seller's text claims it is a Toyota Sienna 2005 automatic 2WD gearbox.

claims.claim: Toyota sienna 2005 automatic transmission gear box -2WD
claims.evidence: No readable identification plate or casting number is visible in photo 0; the seller's words alone are not proof.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (gears, clutches, hydraulics) cannot be assessed from the outside.
risks.proof: Video of the input shaft rotating smoothly under power, or a bench-test report.

risks.risk: Fitment to a 2005 Toyota Sienna 2WD is unconfirmed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the transmission identification plate or part number matched to that vehicle.

risks.risk: Casing cracks or broken mounting ears may be hidden by dirt.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides, especially the bell housing and mounting points.

risks.risk: Torque converter, valve body, or sensors may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing the complete assembly with the converter attached.

proof_requests: Clear photo of any identification plate or casting number on the transmission casing.
Close-up photos of the bell housing, mounting ears, and all sides of the casing.
Photo showing whether the torque converter is included.
Video or proof that the transmission came from a running 2005 Toyota Sienna 2WD.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as an automatic transmission gear box, so a worst-case price can be set despite unverified make, model, condition, and fitment claims.
